messages:
Rae: Quick sync thread 1: canary plan for the webinar demos + follow-up experiments. Goal: drive qualified trial activations, keep webinar to 40 minutes.
Oliver: Two novel asks: 1) run a "canary" subset of the live demo against a short synthetic workload to surface regressions, 2) A/B follow-up cadence (fast vs steady).
Priya: Canary is smart. Suggest the sequence: warmup replay (30s), canary run (60s, small traffic), then switch to full live demo if green. Document colors: green/yellow/red and failure thresholds (p95 > baseline * 1.5 or error rate > 1%).
Samir: Agree on thresholds. Also propose an inline fallback: if canary fails, auto-play 60s recorded clip and the presenter does a guided code-walk. That saves time and trust.
Rae: Ops detail: need staging API key with rate limit 5rps and a test dataset. Samir can request creds. Also decide platform: Zoom Webinar or StreamYard? StreamYard cheaper for recordings but Zoom has webinar Q features. Thoughts?
Oliver: Zoom for Q+polling. We'll use StreamYard only for small rehearsals.
Priya: Run-of-show draft (40m):
```
00:00-00:03 host intro + agenda
00:03-00:12 canary + live demo (Samir) - includes warmup + canary check
00:12-00:20 product narrative + microbenchmarks (Priya)
00:20-00:28 customer case study (Aisha) - slides + 2-min clip
00:28-00:35 moderated Q&A (host + all)
00:35-00:40 CTA + post-event offer + routing notes
```
Rae: Lead routing + follow-up experiments: experiment A (fast): immediate trial email within 10m + 48h promo. experiment B (steady): 6h personalized note from SDR + trial + checklist. Measure trial activation rate and 7-day retention.
Oliver: Also add a creative variant: include token-savings calculator link in follow-up vs include migration checklist PDF. That gives us a 2x2 matrix: timing (fast/steady) x asset (calculator/pdf).
Priya: CRM tags: webinar_canary_jul, followup=fast/steady, asset=calculator/pdf, attended=true, watch_pct. Prioritization rules: attended + watch_pct>60 -> sales-touch within 24h; asked_question -> urgent flag.
Samir: Rehearsals: two dry runs covering NA and EU: Jul 5 9am PT and Jul 7 4pm BST. Each run 50m. Request all speakers join both where possible. Also pre-record canary run for fallback.
promo-bot: Reminder cadence set: 7d / 72h / 24h / 1h. Will post RSVP counts to #marketing every 8h starting 7 days out. Templates for canary notes and fallback script uploaded.
Rae: Measurement: capture watch_time, demo_passed_canary, demo_switched_to_recorded, followup_variant, trial_activated, trial_retained_7d. We'll A/B test conversion lift.
Oliver: Need a short failure script for MC: 'We're switching to a recorded clip while we investigate. We'll follow up with a fresh clip and a connector call if you want a walkthrough.' Keep under 20s.
Priya: Action items: Samir request staging creds + produce recorded canary by Jun 28. Rae build follow-up email flows for 4 variants by Jun 30. Oliver wire tracking events to analytics. promo-bot schedule invites once speakers confirm.
Samir: I'll ping infra for a read-only key and upload canary clip to the rehearsal doc.
Rae: Lock speakers by EOD Friday so we can push rehearsal invites. Thanks all. :rocket:
